headline.tier: STP DEFAULT FLIP — 3.28x faster + 100% A2W primary
headline.metrics: wall clock 506s (vs 1660s w/STP); A2W primary 100% (vs 87.5%); W2A 52% (vs 35%)
headline.summary: STP (Short-Term Plasticity) was 57% of inner-loop step time AND silently degrading binding accuracy by ~12-25pp. 3-seed validation showed STP-off is BOTH 3.28x faster AND more accurate. Default flipped 2026-05-10. Largest single optimization win of the arc — compounds with cloud H100 to ~44-74x baseline. Re-validation of prior multi-seed results recommended.

8-word Phase 1.3 + Tier 2.1 — CLS at synonym scale
8-word strict anti-cheat — cortex truly retains
pillars.metric: 3/3 GO, identical to non-strict (eval not artifact)

pillars.name: 12-word default arch — capacity boundary defined

pillars.name: Phase 1.5 unified suite — sequential regime sound
pillars.metric: 2/4 PASS multi-seed: sequential 0.95 + retention 0.94 (both 3/3); interference 0.39 + long_tail 0.23 fail

pillars.name: Phase 1.5 v400 interference — under-training hypothesis refuted
pillars.metric: v200 0.340 -> v400 0.345; failure is architectural not dose-bound

pillars.name: Phase 1.5 n_motor=2000 interference — capacity hypothesis refuted
pillars.metric: v400 + n=2000 score 0.390 (+0.045 vs n=1000); below 0.50 threshold; both tunable levers fail

pillars.name: Phase 2.3b 50M-param cosine smoke — scale hypothesis REFUTED
pillars.metric: 134K cosine 0.72 -> 50M cosine 0.85 (WORSE); bigger model pushes features more alike across direction words; path-f-hybrid is dead-end at single-3090 scale

pillars.name: Track 3 layer 4 :speak — 6-seed multi-seed VALIDATED
pillars.metric: A2W mean 58.3% +/- 20.4% (5/6 seeds at >= 50%, 5/6 above chance); single-seed 75% reproduces; per-direction N=67% E=67% S=67% W=33%

pillars.name: Tier 2.1 8-word :speak (production-side analog) — 6/6 GO EXCEEDS paper
pillars.metric: A2W any-synonym mean 87.5% +/- 20.9% (6/6 above 50%, 5/6 at 100%); paper's 6/6 aligned reproduces and exceeds (paper was 63.7% +/- 11.8%); STDP WTA primary-wins confirmed at production-side (synonym top-1 0% across all seeds)

pillars.name: 64-word smoke — capacity rule extends to 16 sub-pops/motor_X
pillars.metric: pre-silence primary 62.5% (anchor binding scales to 64-word vocab!); retention primary 76% (just under 80% threshold); retention synonym 157% (anomalous, secondaries IMPROVE post-hippo-silence)

pillars.name: STP DEFAULT FLIPPED — 3.28x faster + accuracy improved
pillars.metric: 3-seed validation: wall clock 506s vs 1660s (3.28x); A2W primary 100% vs 87.5% (+12.5pp); W2A 52% vs 35% (+17pp). STP was 57% of inner-loop step time AND degrading binding via millisecond synaptic fatigue. Default flipped in chat training paths.

capacity_rule.rule: n_motor / sub_pops_per_motor_X >= ~333 neurons per sub-population (empirical, derived 2026-05-09)

phase_status.active: STP default flipped to False after 3-seed validation showed 3.28x speedup AND accuracy improvement. All chat training paths now use STP-off. Major optimization win — compounds with cloud H100 to ~44-74x baseline.
phase_status.next: Re-run prior multi-seed results at STP-off (Tier 1 6-seed, Tier 2.1 8-word 6-seed, Phase 1.4 BRANCH A retention, 64-word smoke) — predicted to push primary binding to ~95-100%.
phase_status.after_next: Encoding-axis 64-word smoke at STP-off (~3 hr instead of 9.4 hr at STP-on). Tests user's hypothesis that lang_input encoding (not motor capacity) is the real bottleneck at higher vocab tiers.
phase_status.after_after: Webapp chat UI WebSocket (1-2 day project; bridges library backend + saved-bridges tab UI shipped tonight). Cloud deploy with optimized stack.
